description: The elevation scope of Accessible first: its answers, its usage rules and the semantic tokens it owns. The loader joins it with scheme.json.

answers.question: elevation.roles
answers.why: Flat is easier to read at high zoom.

answers.question: elevation.definition
answers.why: Strong borders separate groups at any zoom.

answers.question: elevation.values
answers.why: No shadows; borders do the work.

answers.question: elevation.lands
answers.why: Only dialogs separate, with a dimmed page and a border.

usage.why: Shadows are hard to see; borders are not.

usage.use: A strong border and a dimmed page
usage.why: The dimmed page makes the dialog obvious.

elevation.card.headline: Lines, not shadows.
elevation.card.line: Cards show their edge, so no one depends on a shadow.

elevation.overlay.headline: No shadow.
elevation.overlay.line: Layers use a clear edge in place of a shadow.
